data.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Binance Spot Block Matching
data.body: {"node":"root","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"text","text":"1. What is Spot Block Matching and what are its benefits?"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Spot Block Matching is a convenient way to buy or sell sizable amounts of cryptocurrency. Whitelisted spot users can initiate Spot Block Matching requests (the “Maker”) by entering the trade detail request of the allowed pair, to be accepted by another whitelisted spot user (the “Taker”) for the Spot Block Match. The trade detail request can be accepted by the Taker by pasting the Settlement Key (which was generated to the Maker and relayed privately to the Taker). "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Please note:"}]},{"node":"text","text":" The Spot Block Matching service is not related to the Spot Order Book and bookings will be made entirely outside of the market and strictly between the whitelisted Maker and Taker."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"To facilitate Spot Block Matching and provide access to Spot Block matching 24/7, we have created a Spot Block Trade UI which can be accessed by whitelisted UIDs. These UIDs are whitelisted per their master account. For whitelisting requests, please contact either  your sales or key account Spot coverage team; or "},{"node":"element","tag":"a","attr":{"href":"mailto:vip@binance.com"},"child":[{"node":"text","text":"vip@binance.com"}]},{"node":"text","text":". "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Please note: "}]},{"node":"text","text":"Spot Block Matching is currently only available on the Binance website."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"text","text":"2. Who can participate in Spot Block Matching?"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"To participate in Spot Block Matching, both the Maker and Taker must be logged into the Binance account with the whitelisted UID to initiate/accept the trade booking. "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Please note: "}]},{"node":"text","text":"This function only supports master accounts."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Whitelisted users can act as both Maker and Taker. However, only Makers can initiate Spot Block Matching."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Each Spot Block Matching trade acceptance default time validity is "},{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"30 minutes"}]},{"node":"text","text":" from the Maker’s confirmation of trade creation. The Maker has the ability to extend the validity period for acceptance of the trade, as many times as required, with each extension being for "},{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"30 minutes"}]},{"node":"text","text":"."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"The Maker has the ability to cancel the order directly, whilst the Taker can ignore any Maker request."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"text","text":"3. What trading pairs are available for Spot Block Matching?"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Available trading pairs are subject to continuous review by Binance and will be based on user feedback. "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"text","text":"4. What are the applicable fees for participation in Spot Block Matching?"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Maker and Taker fees are both 0.025%. "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Please note:"}]},{"node":"text","text":" Market maker rebate fees are not available for Spot Block Matching."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"text","text":"5. Is there a minimum value for an eligible trade for Spot Block Matching?"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"You may refer to the Spot Trading Rules page to view the minimum value for an eligible trade for Spot Block Matching. "}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"When initiating each Spot Block Matching request, the trade can be placed by the Maker at "},{"node":"element","tag":"strong","child":[{"node":"text","text":"up to 10% above or below the market price"}]},{"node":"text","text":" for the respective trading pair. This percentage may fluctuate thereafter depending upon the market price at the time that the Taker accepts the trade."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"text","text":"6. How does settlement take place for Spot Block Matching and how long does it take?"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Trades are settled directly to the master account’s Spot Account, as Spot Block Matching only supports master accounts. Settlement takes place immediately after you trade."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"h3","child":[{"node":"text","text":"7. What legal terms apply to Spot Block Matching?"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"p","child":[{"node":"text","text":"When you trade with Binance, you are subject to the Binance "},{"node":"element","tag":"a","attr":{"href":"/en/terms"},"child":[{"node":"text","text":"Terms of Use"}]},{"node":"text","text":". You may be subject to localized versions of these terms when onboarding to local Binance entities. You may also be required to accept additional terms and conditions depending on the scope of services offered. Should you have any questions, please contact "},{"node":"element","tag":"a","attr":{"href":"/en/support/chat-invitation"},"child":[{"node":"text","text":"Binance Support."}]}]}]}
